About these 38 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Saturday has the most, with 11. The earliest start is F(RIDE)day Coffee Ride at 7:15 am; the latest is TITS Tuesday (Time in the Saddle) at 8:00 pm. After work, 22 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 15 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 13. There are 5 rides made for women, trans and femme riders and 2 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 18 and Nov 9, 2026.
